persons.name: Jīvadhana
persons.evidence: mānaṃdhra jiodhanaṃ (5) hlāsa mudariṃgāsa coyā jula

relations.evidence: cakanāsiṃyā dharmmacesnā svacita tayāo dayāla || 0 || kipudesa rāchicācheyā mānaṃdhra jiodhanaṃ (5) hlāsa mudariṃgāsa coyā jula

purpose: dharmmacesnā svacita tayāo dayāla ... thugu dharmmana satvaprānipani śuṣāvati prāpta
notes: The catalogue gives the place of copying as Kathmandu, which is the residence of the commissioner (yadesa kyalatora, i.e., Keltole, Kathmandu). However, the colophon explicitly specifies that the manuscript was copied in Lhasa at Mudariṃgā ('hlāsa mudariṃgāsa coyā jula') by a scribe originally from Kirtipur ('kipudesa rāchicācheyā').
